title: microlicia raymondii
intro: Microlicia raymondii, commonly known as "wild coffee", is a plant species native to the Brazilian Atlantic Forest. The health benefits of Microlicia raymondii include antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of this plant include stimulating the nervous system, acting as a diuretic, and possessing antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Microlicia raymondii include alkaloids and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
